result.title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
result.comment: 65 pages, including references and appendices; under review
result.summary: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需对应的盲 PnP 位姿估计方法 MomentPnP：用十四阶以内的置换不变图像矩在观测 2D 点与投影 3D 点之间匹配以初始化位姿，再用 EM 迭代精化位姿与对应权重。
AI.relevance_reason: 置换不变矩提供了紧凑的集合级几何表示、EM 的软对应权重可作为视觉证据筛选与对应关系的线索，但该工作为纯几何位姿求解、不涉及 VLM 推理，可供核查的迁移价值有限。
